title_o: Artful paltering: The risks and rewards of using truthful statements to mislead others.

replications.quote: "The key finding that individuals evaluate those who palter and those who lie by commission as being equally unethical was successfully replicated. In the original study, the contrast between the paltering and lying conditions in simple linear regression assessing the effect of condition on ratings of the unethicality of the Buyer indicated a non-significant p-value (p = .91); this p-value was also non-significant in the present replication (p = .90)."
